  SUM(QT_MAT_PROF_TEC_CONC) AS total_tec_conc,
  SUM(QT_MAT_PROF_TEC_SUBS) AS total_tec_sub
FROM 
  matriculas
WHERE 
  TP_DEPENDENCIA = 'Federal';

SELECT 
  SUM(QT_MAT_PROF_TEC_CONC) AS total_tec_conc,
  SUM(QT_MAT_PROF_TEC_SUBS) AS total_tec_sub,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(QT_MAT_PROF_TEC_CONC) > SUM(QT_MAT_PROF_TEC_SUBS) THEN 'Técnico Concomitante'
    WHEN SUM(QT_MAT_PROF_TEC_CONC) < SUM(QT_MAT_PROF_TEC_SUBS) THEN 'Técnico Subsequente'
    ELSE 'Ambos iguais'
  END AS tipo_tec
FROM 
  matriculas
WHERE 
  TP_DEPENDENCIA = 'Federal';

  SUM(QT_MAT_prof) AS total_prof,
  SUM(QT_MAT_prof_tec) AS total_tec

  matriculas

  AND QT_TRANSP_PUBLICO = 'N'
  AND QT_TRANSP_RESP_EST = 'N'
  AND QT_TRANSP_RESP_MUN = 'N'
  AND TP_PODER_PUBLICO_PARCERIA = 'F'
  AND QT_MAT_PROF > 0
  AND QT_MAT_PROF_TEC > 0
  AND CO_ENTIDADE IN ('INEP', 'MEC', 'EDUCAR', 'PAC', 'MEC', 'FEDERAL');
